analysis.reasoning: Amazon reported strong Q2 results with revenue and operating income exceeding guidance. The management team demonstrated high confidence in their 'regionalization' strategy, which is driving significant cost efficiencies in the logistics network. While AWS growth has stabilized at 12% due to customer cost-optimization efforts, the tone regarding Generative AI (Bedrock, Trainium, Inferentia) was highly optimistic and innovation-driven. CapEx is projected to decrease slightly year-over-year, reflecting a shift from general fulfillment expansion toward targeted AI infrastructure. The QA session was direct, with management providing specific context on AWS trends and grocery strategy without significant evasion.
